conditions.description: Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary (host organisation) in the academic or non-academic sector; the fellowship is a single-beneficiary action recruiting the researcher.
The researcher must undertake international mobility (European PF: coming to Europe or moving within Europe; Global PF: outgoing phase to a non-associated Third Country with a mandatory return).
Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are restricted to European nationals or long-term residents.
Admissibility conditions and proposal page limits/layout apply as described in Annex A and Annex E of the Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annexes and in Part B of the Application Form.

Eligible countries for participation and funding are those described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes, including specific provisions for certain non-EU/non-Associated Countries described in the Horizon Europe Programme Guide.
Other eligibility conditions are those described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes.
Applicants must satisfy financial and operational capacity requirements as described in Annex C of the Work Programme General Annexes.

For MSCA PF proposals in research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme, specific eligibility conditions apply, and organisations active in nuclear research must be established in an EU Member State or a country associated to the Euratom Programme.
